hero.tagline: with the best all in one social platform.
hero.description: Our website puts everything you sell-Videos, image gallery, Audio clips, merch, products, even paid calls—into one platform so fans can buy in seconds and you get paid fast.

communities.title: Your communities all linked up
communities.description: Automated social media promotion keeps your content circulating while you focus on creating. Stay linked to your fans via Telegram integration and receive calls anywhere on the go.

reach.title: Maximize Your Reach
reach.description: Our website provides you flexible settings on access controls and content management so you don’t have to limit the way you sell. Create free media contents and subscription tiers to attract new followers or reserve premium content and events for top supporters only with our advanced settings.

paid.title: Scale smarter. Get paid faster.
paid.description: You earned it, you get it. Our system processes your funds in under 10 minutes. Seriously. Plus, ditch the guesswork: our real-time analytics are like a cheat code, showing you exactly what content makes the most money so you can duplicate the success.

featured.title: Featured Creator
featured.subtitle: 100+ content creator have already join us

ditch.title: Ditch the Agency Middleman
ditch.subtitle: Your Platform is Now Your Full-Service Team.
ditch.body: Why pay an outside agency when there is a team of agent-level experts in Our Website? Selected creators get 1-on-1 expert support completely free of commission fees or 3rd party charges. Let our in-house support team handle your outreach and growth while you focus on creating.

services.title: Stop Jumping Between Platforms.
services.subtitle: Start Thriving in One Dynamic Ecosystem.

ecosystem.title: Build your ultimate revenue generating ecosystem
ecosystem.body: Upload physical merch, digital downloads, exclusive videos, or image sets all in one place. The possibility to sell is endless : Simply sell them as pay per views, or make your content exclusive by controlling media and product access to subscribers only. Our website's seamless ecosystems even allows you to upsell in other revenue streams like live call and group events!

strategy.title: Real-Time Strategy Optimization
strategy.body: Track sales performance as it happens and instantly tweak your pricing, access settings, or subscription models to maximize conversion based on live data.

reach.title: Global reach on overview
reach.body: New and trending creators and their media will featured on fan's dashboard, helping you connect your profile with like-minded community.

flexible.title: Flexible payment for Every Fan
flexible.body: One price doesn't fit all. Create a customized ladder of support with monthly options for casual viewers and discounted annual plans for your core community, maximizing your recurring revenue.

retention.title: Automated Subscriber Retention
retention.body: Don't let a cancellation be the end of the road. Activate our smart retention tools to automatically offer special discounts or offers when a subscriber attempts to leave, winning them back before they go.

perks.title: Perks That Build Loyalty
perks.body: Give back to the fans who support you most. Configure automatic benefits like free monthly tokens, store-wide discounts on merch, or access to VIP-only media to keep your churn rate low.

loop.title: Keep all your fans in the loop
loop.body: connect your Our website account with your existing social media such as X and Telegram, let everyone know what you're up to in one single post!

instant.title: Instant Call
instant.body: Stay in the loop with your fans no matter where you are! With our Telegram integration, you'll get instant notifications for incoming calls, ensuring you never miss a chance to chat. Plus, effortlessly upsell your items already listed on Our website while you're at it!

booking.title: Booking Schedule
booking.body: Get ready to let your fans book some quality time with you! Set your availability and offer exclusive call requests, plus don't forget to showcase your media and merch during those chats. It's the perfect way to connect and sell at the same time!

group.title: Group Event
group.body: Join forces with fellow Our website creators and expand your fan base! Host exciting group events where you can engage your audience with interactive live streams, like thrilling lucky draws and live auctions. You're in control of who gets to join the fun, and you can even receive tips and gifts from your loyal fans!

pricing.title: Smart Access & Dynamic Pricing
pricing.body: You control the exclusivity. Make products public for maximum reach, gate them for subscribers only, or offer automated discounts to your loyalest fans. You can even flash-sell items live during events.

custom.title: Custom request
custom.body: Open a high-value revenue stream by accepting paid custom orders through your profile. Whether it's personalized shoutouts or custom-made goods, let fans commission you directly.

broadcast.title: Broadcast in real-time to a global audience
broadcast.body: Build your own loyal communities through scheduled live streaming events - chat with them during events, set and achieve tipping goals together and offer attractive offers or lucky draw to your viewers, creating your own kind of community hangout!

wish.title: Wish Tender
wish.body: Create wish list directly on Our website and let your fans send you gifts through your favourite online shopping platforms securely, and ensure your sensitive information stay private.

safety.title: Your safety is our business.
safety.body: We employ the most advanced encryption and secure protocols to safeguard your personal information. KYC helps us create a secure environment by verifying identities, protecting you from impersonators and fraudulent accounts.

1.text: Having a dedicated account manager at Our website means I always have someone in my corner. They plan my long-term goals and celebrate my wins. It's more than a service; it's a true partnership.

2.text: The ‘full-service’ promise is real. I have a dedicated account manager, a content strategist, and a promo team. Our website handle the analytics so I can handle the art. My content is authentic because I’m not burnt out on the business side.

3.text: Having a strategist, a manager, and a promo expert dedicated to my success makes all the difference. I'm not just using a platform; I'm part of an ecosystem that wants me to win. 🏆

page.weeklyToWalletNote: Our ledger → payout record → wallet load → completion.
page.withdrawSavedNote: Saved beneficiary → prepare balance → preview → payout.
page.withdrawNewNote: Country → dynamic fields → beneficiary → preview → payout.

popup.setupBody: We’ll create your payout account, verify your identity and enable your creator wallet.

popup.legalBody: These details are used to create the Cosmo cardholder/account.
popup.accountCreatedAfter: . We link it to the creator in our DB.
popup.failureBranchBody: if account/card creation fails, no active payout account is created locally.
popup.verifyBody: KYC is SAN-based, so documents are submitted after the Cosmo account exists.
popup.documentsSubmittedBody: Identity and address documents have been submitted against the creator SAN.
popup.verificationPendingBody: While verification is not final, we refresh the latest status whenever the creator returns to Payouts.
popup.rejectedBody: show the provider rejection reason and allow resubmission.
popup.accountActiveBody: The creator is verified and can receive weekly wallet payouts.
popup.weeklyBody: Our own ledger remains the source of truth for earnings.
popup.recordFirstBody: Reserve the amount, set Processing and create a unique reference before calling Cosmo.
popup.walletLoadAcceptedBody: Cosmo loaded the creator wallet and returned a provider transaction reference.
popup.walletLoadFailureBody: insufficient corporate ABL or provider rejection leaves the payout uncompleted and safely restores/releases reserved funds.
popup.walletRefreshedBody: Wallet balance remains separate from unpaid platform earnings.
popup.savedBanksLoadedBody: We fetched the creator’s Cosmo beneficiaries and reconciled them with our stored beneficiary IDs.
popup.balancePreparedSavedBody: Check secondary balance and move funds from card to secondary account where required.
popup.balancePreparedNewBody: Check secondary balance and move card funds if required.
popup.payoutSubmittedBody: Provider payout reference saved. Local withdrawal is Processing.
popup.savedCompletedBody: Provider payout status resolved to Completed.
popup.failedBody: store safe provider reason and verify provider balance before retry.
popup.newBankBody: Add a new beneficiary and immediately use it for this withdrawal.
popup.countriesLoadedBody: Populate the destination-country list from Cosmo.
popup.unsupportedBody: do not render guessed bank fields.
popup.fieldsLoadedBody: The next form uses Cosmo’s acceptable-fields response for the selected country.
popup.bankSavedBody: Cosmo returned a beneficiary reference; we store that ID plus safe masked metadata.
popup.validationFailureBody: remain on the bank-details step and show provider field error.
popup.newCompletedBody: The payout completed and the new bank remains saved for future withdrawals.
